attchmntText: Aarti Surfactants Limited has informed the Exchange about Reconstitution of Committees
voiceSummary: Aarti Surfactants Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The Board also approved the reconstitution of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Stakeholders Relationship Committee. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 2,166.53 lakh rupees on a standalone basis and 2,150.34 lakh rupees on a consolidated basis. Revenue from operations stood at 56,410.53 lakh rupees. The statutory auditors, Gokhale & Sathe LLP, issued a limited review report stating that the financial results do not contain any material misstatement.

attchmntText: Aarti Surfactants Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aarti Surfactants Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The Board also approved the reconstitution of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Stakeholders Relationship Committee. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the Standalone Net Profit was Rs. 2,166.53 lakhs, compared to Rs. 468.67 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. The Consolidated Net Profit for the same period was Rs. 2,150.34 lakhs, versus Rs. 449.99 lakhs previously. Standalone revenue from operations for the six months was Rs. 56,410.53 lakhs. The statutory auditors, Gokhale & Sathe LLP, issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified.
